title: DGMS Safety Alert: Hazards of Goaf Edge Support Setting During Depillaring
text: Fatal accidents repeatedly occur when dressing crews or support mistrys enter the goaf edge under unsupported shale/sandstone roof to erect chocks or withdraw timber. Inquiry findings: Mandatory requirement for mobile canopy protection, breaker props set from secured vantage positions, and continuous sounding with extension rods.
source: DGMS Directorate of Mines Safety Alerts

title: DGMS Safety Alert: Hidden Slip Planes and Slickensides in Laminated Roof Strata
text: Geological slip planes and slickensides frequently cause sudden detached falls without conventional audible warning signs (cracking/creaking). Visual inspection alone is insufficient. Mines must utilize strata endoscopes / bore inspection cameras and install tell-tales across bedding planes.
source: DGMS Directorate of Mines Safety Alerts

title: DGMS Safety Alert: Solid Blasting Dynamic Vibration and Secondary Delamination
text: Solid blasting induces high ground vibrations (PPV > 10 mm/s) that weaken the bonding between immediate shale layers and main sandstone roof. Mandatory protocol: Minimum waiting period of 30 minutes after blasting, statutory ventilation clearance, and rigorous mechanical dressing before deploying drilling or loading crews.
source: DGMS Directorate of Mines Safety Alerts
